Dual compression: AC-Memory + History with auto-compress & refined Writer prompts

- AC-Memory: auto-compress on append\(\) when threshold exceeded \(was missing\)
- History: auto-save state in accumulate_raw\(\), simplified to char thresholds only
- Writer prompts: tier-specific compression targets \(10-15%\), proper style guidance

- Removed count thresholds - chars only to avoid parsing errors
- Collection tier now grows indefinitely \(final archive, no promotion\)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
